_doc: MCP servers for code-scalpel. Copy to .code-scalpel/mcp.json to enable. The top-level key is `mcpServers` (Claude-Desktop-compatible — paste a server block from any client config and it works). The legacy `servers` key is still read for back-compat; if both are present, `mcpServers` wins. Transport is chosen by fields: `command` → stdio (subprocess), `url` → Streamable HTTP (remote). SSE is not supported.

playwright._note: stdio transport (the @playwright/mcp default). Do NOT pass --port; that switches the server to SSE, which code-scalpel does not support.

remote-example._note: Streamable HTTP transport. `headers` is optional (static auth only — no interactive OAuth this iteration). Tool args are sent to this external endpoint, so only point it at a server you trust.
